newsitem.title: UK: Old crop LIFFE wheat falls, little change in new.
newsitem.headline: Old crop LIFFE wheat falls, little change in new.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended a subdued day's business with the old crop well down again while new crop months were mostly unchanged.
Active November last traded unchanged at 86.25 stg on volume of 211 of a total 426 lots.
But July, which took up most of the rest of the trade with 137 lots, last traded 1.25 stg lower at 77.50 stg.
"The old crop spiralled down to another low at 77 stg, but there was a bit of a bounce," one trader said, noting that some remaining long holders wanted to get out before the first tender on Tuesday.
On the new crop he expected to see wheat struggle in the face of the strengthening sterling, despite Monday's lacklustre performance.
Activity in barley was limited to 23 lots of November, which last traded unchanged at 83.00 stg.
The physical market was quiet, with brokers expecting it to remain so until the new harvest. They reported feed wheat done to Norfolk/Suffolk for July at 82.50 stg and 83 stg.
